name: Wax
subtitle: Local IPA inspector and signer
description: Wax checks IPA files and manages your own signing certificates and provisioning profiles on-device.

apps.name: Wax
apps.subtitle: Inspect IPAs, manage certificates and profiles
apps.localizedDescription:
Import an .ipa and see its real metadata: bundle id, version, minimum iOS, executable and whether signature or profile files are present. Import your own .p12 and provisioning profiles; private keys stay in the iOS Keychain and passwords are never stored.

This build does not sign or install apps yet. Signature validity and installation eligibility are never claimed.
